hellowork.title: Senior Product Manager Orienté·e Data & ai H/F
hellowork.qualifications: Tu as idéalement 4 à 7+ ans d'expérience en Product Management , avec une expérience significative sur un produit SaaS B2B. Tu as déjà porté un périmètre produit de bout en bout : discovery, conception, delivery, lancement et mesure de l'adoption. Tu es autonome dans l'analyse de données produit : SQL ou équivalent, funnels, cohortes, segmentation et analyse d'usage. Tu as déjà réellement travaillé sur des produits ou fonctionnalités reposant sur de la Data, de l'IA ou de l'automatisation . Tu possèdes suffisamment de culture technique pour discuter efficacement avec des développeurs sur des sujets d'API, modèle de données, architecture, sécurité ou dette technique. Tu sais écrire clairement et documenter tes décisions et arbitrages. Et surtout, tu sais prendre une ambition large et en sortir un premier produit suffisamment réduit pour être livré, mais suffisamment complet pour tester sa valeur. Une expérience approfondie dans au moins deux des domaines suivants sera particulièrement pertinente : Data Products et Data Quality, LLM et IA générative, automatisation ou moteurs de règles, analytics et dashboards, API et produits plateforme. Expérience d'un produit multi-tenant, B2B2C, packaging à l'usage, n8n/Make/Zapier ou scripting léger : ce sont des plus. Il n'est pas nécessaire de connaître l'univers alumni ou l'enseignement supérieur.
hellowork.descriptionHtml:
Les missions du poste


AlumnForce est la solution web et mobile (SaaS) destinée à toutes les formations et associations qui souhaitent bâtir un réseau social professionnel dynamique pour leurs membres, étudiants, diplômés, enseignants et recruteurs.

AlumnForce est leader en France, reconnue comme experte dans le développement des réseaux sociaux universitaires et gère aujourd'hui plus de 4 500 000 comptes sur plus de 380 réseaux, en France, et 14 autres pays (HEC Alumni, Centraliens, ESSEC, AX Polytechnique, Universités, IAE, Sciences Po, SNCF, PWC, ADECCO, RENAULT, ENGIE ...)

Notre ambition est de fédérer les membres d'une même organisation sur un réseau communautaire de confiance.

Notre mission principale est d'aider à engager des communautés pour cultiver des liens humains et professionnels durables.

L'application propose plus de 40 modules fonctionnels avec des sujets de développement variés par son approche SaaS et B2B2C.

Nos valeurs sont :

- la passion de l'innovation digital,
- le plaisir de travailler en équipe,
- la bienveillance,
- le goût pour les challenges,
- le respect des engagements,
- la curiosité

Venez rejoindre un projet humain et social en pleine accélération !




Notre plateforme stocke beaucoup de données. Notre ambition pour 2027 est qu'elle soit capable d'agir intelligemment dessus.

Notre Cap 2027 repose notamment sur trois piliers :

Donnée fiable moteurs Data & IA valeur métier mesurable == gain de temps des animateurs de communauté et impact compris

Concrètement, cela doit se traduire par :

du temps gagné pour les administrateurs de communauté grâce à l'automatisation

des échanges plus pertinents avec les membres grâce à une meilleure connaissance de leurs profils, besoins et attentes

un impact mesurable pour les responsables qui doivent démontrer la valeur du réseau auprès de leur direction

Nous travaillons sur des sujets comme :

qualification, enrichissement et normalisation des données ;

agents IA capables d'utiliser les données et fonctionnalités AlumnForce ;

recherche et segmentation conversationnelles ;

dashboards et indicateurs permettant de mesurer l'impact d'un réseau ;

ouverture contrôlée de la plateforme aux assistants IA de nos clients via MCP ;

automatisations permettant de déclencher des actions à partir de la donnée.

Nous recherchons un·e Senior Product Manager Data & AI capable de transformer ces ambitions en produits réellement utilisés, mesurables et monétisables.

Tu travailleras en parallèle avec un Product Designer orienté Product Management, particulièrement impliqué sur l'expérience utilisateur, les parcours, le prototypage et la simplification des interfaces complexes.

Tes missions :

Transformer notre donnée en produit

Une base alumni évolue en permanence : changements d'entreprise ou de métier, données incomplètes, doublons, informations obsolètes ou difficilement comparables entre réseaux.

Notre ambition est progressivement de construire une base qui s'améliore plutôt que de simplement stocker ce qu'on lui donne.

Tu travailleras notamment sur la qualité et la fraîcheur des données, la classification des métiers et entreprises, les référentiels, l'enrichissement, la détection d'anomalies et les mécanismes permettant aux utilisateurs de confirmer ou mettre à jour leurs informations.

Ton objectif n'est pas d'accumuler davantage de données : il est d'identifier quelle donnée est nécessaire pour créer de la valeur produit.

Concevoir nos produits Data & IA

Selon les priorités et ton périmètre, tu pourras notamment travailler sur :

**Agents IA
**Créer un socle permettant à des agents de disposer d'instructions, de connaissances et de compétences, puis d'utiliser les outils et données AlumnForce en respectant les droits de chaque utilisateur.

**Recherche et segmentation conversationnelles
**Permettre par exemple à un administrateur de demander :

« Trouve-moi les diplômés travaillant dans la finance à Londres depuis plus de trois ans » puis d'exploiter directement ce segment.

**MCP et ouverture agentique
**Permettre à certains clients d'interroger leurs données AlumnForce depuis leurs propres assistants IA avec les contrôles d'accès, la sécurité et la traçabilité nécessaires.

**Dashboards et indicateurs
**Transformer nos données en informations exploitables par les directions : engagement, carrière, insertion professionnelle ou impact du réseau.

Concevoir une IA mesurable et maîtrisée

Une fonctionnalité IA n'est pas terminée lorsqu'elle fonctionne bien pendant une démonstration.

Tu dois pouvoir répondre à des questions comme :

Quelle est la qualité réelle des résultats ? Sur quels cas l'agent échoue-t-il ? Comment mesurer cette qualité ? Quel est le coût d'une utilisation ? Quels clients génèrent ces coûts ? Quand faut-il garder un humain dans la boucle ? Quelles données l'agent a-t-il réellement le droit de consulter ?

Qualité, coûts, sécurité, RGPD, permissions et observabilité font partie du produit dès sa conception.

Porter le cycle produit de bout en bout

Tu pratiques régulièrement la discovery auprès de nos clients, administrateurs et utilisateurs.

Tu confrontes les entretiens aux données comportementales : usage des fonctionnalités, funnels, cohortes, rétention et différences entre segments de clients.

Tu explores plusieurs solutions avec le design et la tech, puis tu identifies le MVP qui permettra de tester réellement l'hypothèse.

Savoir réduire fortement un périmètre sans supprimer sa valeur est l'une des compétences les plus importantes du poste.

Notre ambition 2027 est importante : nous ne pourrons pas tout construire en même temps.

Tu devras donc savoir décider ce que nous construisons maintenant, ce que nous repoussons et ce que nous choisissons volontairement de ne pas faire.

Une fois le produit livré, tu participes également à son lancement avec le marketing, les Customer Success et les KAM et tu mesures son adoption réelle.

Utiliser également l'IA pour améliorer notre façon de travailler

Nous voulons appliquer à notre propre organisation ce que nous construisons dans notre produit.

Tu utiliseras donc régulièrement l'IA et l'automatisation pour améliorer les processus Produit : synthèse de feedbacks, qualification des demandes, préparation de specs, analyse de données, documentation ou scénarios de recette.

Nous recherchons ici des automatisations fiables, mesurables et réutilisables, pas uniquement des démonstrateurs.

Tu as idéalement 4 à 7+ ans d'expérience en Product Management, avec une expérience significative sur un produit SaaS B2B.Tu as déjà porté un périmètre produit de bout en bout : discovery, conception, delivery, lancement et mesure de l'adoption.Tu es autonome dans l'analyse de données produit : SQL ou équivalent, funnels, cohortes, segmentation et analyse d'usage.Tu as déjà réellement travaillé sur des produits ou fonctionnalités reposant sur de la Data, de l'IA ou de l'automatisation.Tu possèdes suffisamment de culture technique pour discuter efficacement avec des développeurs sur des sujets d'API, modèle de données, architecture, sécurité ou dette technique.Tu sais écrire clairement et documenter tes décisions et arbitrages.Et surtout, tu sais prendre une ambition large et en sortir un premier produit suffisamment réduit pour être livré, mais suffisamment complet pour tester sa valeur.Une expérience approfondie dans au moins deux des domaines suivants sera particulièrement pertinente : Data Products et Data Quality, LLM et IA générative, automatisation ou moteurs de règles, analytics et dashboards, API et produits plateforme.Expérience d'un produit multi-tenant, B2B2C, packaging à l'usage, n8n/Make/Zapier ou scripting léger : ce sont des plus.Il n'est pas nécessaire de connaître l'univers alumni ou l'enseignement supérieur.

Bienvenue chez AlumnForce

Notre ambition est de fédérer les membres d'une même organisation sur un réseau communautaire de confiance.Notre mission principale est d'aider à engager des communautés pour cultiver des liens humains et professionnels durables. L'application propose plus de 40 modules fonctionnels avec des sujets de développement variés par son approche SaaS et B2B2C. Nos valeurs sont :la passion de l'innovation digital,le plaisir de travailler en équipe,la bienveillance,le goût pour les challenges,le respect des engagements,la curiositéVenez rejoindre un projet humain et social en pleine accélération ! 🚀

Mais aussi...

Qualité, coûts, sécurité, RGPD, permissions et observabilité font partie du produit dès sa conception. Porter le cycle produit de bout en bout Tu pratiques régulièrement la discovery auprès de nos clients, administrateurs et utilisateurs. Tu confrontes les entretiens aux données comportementales : usage des fonctionnalités, funnels, cohortes, rétention et différences entre segments de clients. Tu explores plusieurs solutions avec le design et la tech, puis tu identifies le MVP qui permettra de tester réellement l'hypothèse. Savoir réduire fortement un périmètre sans supprimer sa valeur est l'une des compétences les plus importantes du poste. Notre ambition 2027 est importante : nous ne pourrons pas tout construire en même temps. Tu devras donc savoir décider ce que nous construisons maintenant, ce que nous repoussons et ce que nous choisissons volontairement de ne pas faire. Une fois le produit livré, tu participes également à son lancement avec le marketing, les Customer Success et les KAM et tu mesures son adoption réelle. Utiliser également l'IA pour améliorer notre façon de travailler Nous voulons appliquer à notre propre organisation ce que nous construisons dans notre produit. Tu utiliseras donc régulièrement l'IA et l'automatisation pour améliorer les processus Produit : synthèse de feedbacks, qualification des demandes, préparation de specs, analyse de données, documentation ou scénarios de recette. Nous recherchons ici des automatisations fiables, mesurables et réutilisables, pas uniquement des démonstrateurs. Le profil recherché Tu as idéalement 4 à 7+ ans d'expérience en Product Management, avec une expérience significative sur un produit SaaS B2B.Tu as déjà porté un périmètre produit de bout en bout : discovery, conception, delivery, lancement et mesure de l'adoption.Tu es autonome dans l'analyse de données produit : SQL ou équivalent, funnels, cohortes, segmentation et analyse d'usage.Tu as déjà réellement travaillé sur des produits ou fonctionnalités reposant sur de la Data, de l'IA ou de l'automatisation.Tu possèdes suffisamment de culture technique pour discuter efficacement avec des développeurs sur des sujets d'API, modèle de données, architecture, sécurité ou dette technique.Tu sais écrire clairement et documenter tes décisions et arbitrages.Et surtout, tu sais prendre une ambition large et en sortir un premier produit suffisamment réduit pour être livré, mais suffisamment complet pour tester sa valeur.Une expérience approfondie dans au moins deux des domaines suivants sera particulièrement pertinente : Data Products et Data Quality, LLM et IA générative, automatisation ou moteurs de règles, analytics et dashboards, API et produits plateforme.Expérience d'un produit multi-tenant, B2B2C, packaging à l'usage, n8n/Make/Zapier ou scripting léger : ce sont des plus.Il n'est pas nécessaire de connaître l'univers alumni ou l'enseignement supérieur. Bienvenue chez AlumnForce AlumnForce est la solution web et mobile (SaaS) destinée à toutes les formations et associations qui souhaitent bâtir un réseau social professionnel dynamique pour leurs membres, étudiants, diplômés, enseignants et recruteurs.AlumnForce est leader en France, reconnue comme experte dans le développement des réseaux sociaux universitaires et gère aujourd'hui plus de 4 500 000 comptes sur plus de 380 réseaux, en France, et 14 autres pays (HEC Alumni, Centraliens, ESSEC, AX Polytechnique, Universités, IAE, Sciences Po, SNCF, PWC, ADECCO, RENAULT, ENGIE ...) Notre ambition est de fédérer les membres d'une même organisation sur un réseau communautaire de confiance.Notre mission principale est d'aider à engager des communautés pour cultiver des liens humains et professionnels durables. L'application propose plus de 40 modules fonctionnels avec des sujets de développement variés par son approche SaaS et B2B2C. Nos valeurs sont :la passion de l'innovation digital,le plaisir de travailler en équipe,la bienveillance,le goût pour les challenges,le respect des engagements,la curiositéVenez rejoindre un projet humain et social en pleine accélération ! 🚀 Mais aussi... Déroulement des entretiens1. Entretien Product avec le CPO 2. Cas pratique3. Entretien avec 1 Lead Dev et le DG

hellowork.title: Senior ai Product Manager - Hf H/F
hellowork.descriptionHtml:
Détail du poste


AI Product Manager Senior

Un LLM qui hallucine, un RAG dont personne ne sait pourquoi le retrieval part en vrille, un agent qu'on a laissé filer en prod sans garde-fou - tu as déjà vu ça de près, et tu sais exactement quoi faire avant que ça arrive. Ce n'est plus la théorie qui t'intéresse, c'est la stratégie derrière.

Ta mission :

Tu ne découvres plus ce qu'est un LLM, un RAG ou un agent - tu sais où ils cassent en production, et tu as l'expérience pour le dire avant que ça n'arrive. Tu as envie de peser sur la stratégie IA d'un client, pas juste de tenir un backlog.

Hubvisory cherche un AI PM Senior : quelqu'un qui opère en autonomie complète sur des missions IA à enjeu chez des clients grands comptes, avec une vraie double lecture produit et technique - et la capacité de transmettre cette lecture à d'autres.

Tes responsabilités :

- Piloter la stratégie IA d'un client, pas seulement la discovery use case par use case : identifier où l'IA a vraiment de la valeur, et où elle n'en a pas
- Superviser la delivery avec les équipes techniques (AI Engineers, développeurs), avec une vraie latitude d'arbitrage sur les choix d'architecture
- Construire une roadmap IA ancrée dans les objectifs business du client, à l'échelle de plusieurs use cases ou d'un programme
- Challenger les pratiques produit IA au niveau organisationnel - côté client comme côté squad - pas seulement sur un backlog isolé
- Transmettre à des PM ou PM IA plus juniors : structurer leur montée en compétence sur un domaine qui évolue chaque mois
- Construire une relation de confiance à un niveau sponsor, capable de porter un narratif IA face à des interlocuteurs exigeants

Clients : Dior, Decathlon, Saint-Gobain, Carrefour, Leroy Merlin, France TV...

Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?

- Seul cabinet 100% Product & IA en France : tu travailles avec des AI Engineers sur de vraies missions, pas sur des POC
- Revalorisations bi-annuelles, hors période d'essai
- Intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits, redistribué de façon égalitaire
- Campus Hubvisory : 2 semaines d'immersion à l'arrivée + 1000h de contenus à la carte, et Rocketto, notre plateforme e-learning maison sur l'IA
- Mentorat de proximité et buddy dédié dès ton arrivée
- 135 consultants, Paris & Lille, 9,1/10 de satisfaction client

Rémunération :

Fixe entre 52K€ et 58K€ annuels bruts (Paris) + variable + participation aux résultats (jusqu'à 22% des bénéfices) + prime vacances (1% du salaire brut fixe)

Le profil recherché :

Expérience : 5 à 6 ans, avec une vraie maîtrise stratégique des produits IA - pas seulement de la delivery sur des features IA isolées.

Must-have :

- Autonomie complète sur le cycle produit IA, avec une capacité à influencer au-delà d'une squad
- Compréhension approfondie des architectures IA : LLM, RAG, agents, APIs - et de leurs limites concrètes en production
- Socle technique : lecture de Python, SQL, APIs REST/GraphQL
- Expérience de transmission ou de mentorat auprès de profils plus juniors

Atouts :

- Plusieurs produits IA portés jusqu'en production, pas uniquement des POC
- Expérience en environnement grands comptes ou conseil, avec plusieurs missions IA menées
- Capacité à arbitrer une stratégie IA à l'échelle d'un programme, pas juste un use case

Posture :

- Communication proactive, sans attendre qu'on te le demande
- Relation de confiance à un niveau sponsor, pas seulement opérationnelle
- Routine de veille approfondie sur un domaine qui évolue chaque mois

Le process de recrutement :

1 Échange téléphonique avec un recruteur
2 Entretien RH approfondi : parcours, culture produit, rapport à l'IA
3 Case study AI Product
4 Entretien Cofondateur ou VP
5 Retour final et échange sur l'offre

Quelle que soit l'issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum !

hellowork.title: Senior Product Manager - ai H/F
hellowork.descriptionHtml:
Détail du poste


Front is the customer operations platform built for B2B complexity, keeping every team, tool, and customer conversation in sync so companies can scale without losing connection. Others handle simple interactions. Front handles the coordination and context behind complex B2B customer relationships. Over 9,000 companies, including Uber Freight, Navan, and Stripe, rely on Front because it's the only one that can run the operational layer that makes customer-facing work actually succeed.

Backed by Sequoia Capital and Salesforce Ventures, Front has raised $204M from leading venture capital firms and independent investors including top executives at Atlassian, Okta, Qualtrics, Zoom, and PagerDuty. Front has received numerous accolades, including a , , ,, and .

As a Senior Product Manager on the Copilot team, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the AI assistant product embedded in Front's inbox - the central place where teams triage, collaborate, and resolve high-stakes customer communication. This role is central to Front's strategy: embedding Copilot into the moments that matter most in the Inbox (summarize, prioritize, draft, classify, route, and learn) while maintaining the speed, quality, and trust required for customer-facing work. In this role, you'll set direction, work through ambiguity, and collaborate closely with cross-functional partners (engineering, design, marketing, data, sales) to deliver innovative yet intuitive solutions that meet customers' needs and drive business impact. This is a high visibility role that interfaces regularly with our executive team.

What will you be doing?

- Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Front's Copilot product, and how it can help our inbox users with their workflows. Make high-judgment decisions on priorities, tradeoffs, and sequencing to maximize impact
- Use quantitative (e.g. metrics, analytics) and qualitative (e.g. user feedback) data, market and user research, and strong product intuition to identify and prioritize opportunities to continuously improve the product
- Lead end-to-end product development from problem definition through launch and iteration
- Partner deeply with engineering and design to drive outcomes, and collaborate with a wide range of cross-functional partners (including marketing, data, sales and GTM).
- Drive clarity and alignment among key stakeholders across the organization, including executives and adjacent teams.

What skills and experience do you need?

- 7+ years of experience in product management, or related roles, in a technology-driven environment.
- Strong design thinking and systems thinking skills: You can break down complex problems, understand interdependencies, and envision cohesive, scalable solutions that prioritize user experience.
- Excellent product intuition and taste: You know what great looks like and push your team to achieve it.
- Ownership mindset: You take responsibility for outcomes, not just output. You understand how your work drives business impact and can lead your team to focus on high-impact work.
- Customer empathy: You are a champion of the customer and can ship product improvements that address key customer pain points and bring delight.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills: you can manage senior and executive stakeholders; you take control of the narrative and motivate your team; you inspire action with cross-functional partners.
- Execution-oriented: You're comfortable managing many work streams and prioritizing; you know how to make smart trade-offs; you help teams ship on time and with excellent quality.
- Demonstrated fluency with AI: You've used or built AI tooling and understand the nuances of AI products.

What we offer

- Competitive salary
- Equity (we are post-series D & backed by some of the best VCs in the US)
- Private health insurance, including plan options at no cost to employees
- Paid parental leave
- Flexible time off policy
- Flexibility to work from home Monday and Friday, unless posted as a fully remote role
- Mental health support with Workplace Options
- Family planning support with Maven
- $100 per month Lifestyle Stipend to spend on fitness, health and wellness, and other activities
- Wellness Days - Fronteers get an additional day off on months with no holidays
- Winter Break - Our offices are closed from Christmas to New Year's Day!

Front provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability. By applying, you acknowledge and agree that you have read and understand the &

Compensation Range: €85K - €115K

hellowork.title: Product Manager - ai Platform H/F
hellowork.descriptionHtml:
Les missions du poste


At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we're now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It's still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!



Our Product Team

Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams.

Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

- Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team.
- Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app.
- Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell.
- AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability.

The AI Platform task force

AI Platform's mission is to turn Joko into a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside. The tribe builds the internal agent infrastructure that will let every team work faster, automate complex workflows, and create new 0-to-1 features with AI.

Its flagship product is Joker, Joko's internal AI teammate. Already live in Slack, Notion and Linear, Joker can understand context, use tools, act across systems, and take real work from idea to execution. The ambition is not just to automate repetitive tasks, but to make agents a new production layer for how Joko builds and operates.

For this to work at company scale, AI Platform also owns the backbone underneath: Gotham, the identity and permission layer that lets agents act with exactly the access of the person they work for; plus the internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security, reliability and server-cost foundations that keep Joko fast, safe and scalable.

The tribe's users are the teams inside Joko. Its goal is simple: help them run extremely efficient processes, remove operational bottlenecks, and give the company the leverage it needs to scale in the coming years.

What you will do

As Product Manager for the AI Platform task force, you own your roadmap end to end. You will identify the highest-impact internal workflows to transform, define what should be automated or productized, build the roadmap yourself, and ship with a Product Designer and software engineers. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, who leads the tribe. Your users sit a few desks away, which makes discovery fast and accountability unavoidable.

- Build and own your roadmap: You will map what teams do today, where their processes break, what it costs them, and where AI or better tooling can create the most leverage. You will turn that discovery into a clear roadmap, prioritize it yourself, and be accountable for its impact.
- Ship with Engineering: You will work very closely with software engineers to scope, sequence and deliver complex technical products. You will write clear specs, make trade-offs, unblock decisions, test what ships, and keep the team focused on real user impact.
- Build the agent layer: The approach is capability first: expose an action as a scoped tool, write the instructions an agent needs to use it well, then let the agent run the job. Interfaces come only where they earn their place. Deciding what deserves a screen is a genuinely new kind of product judgment.
- Own Joker use cases: You will identify where Joker can take work from idea to execution, automate end-to-end workflows, or help teams create new 0-to-1 features. You will turn these opportunities into production-grade products used every day.
- Retire what should not exist: Part of the mandate is subtractive: migrating off tools that have outlived their purpose and progressively switching off legacy systems. You will sequence those migrations without breaking the teams that depend on them every day.
- Design for trust and scale: You will work on permissions, reliability, security, compliance and data access as product problems. Agents must act safely, every action must be attributable, and the systems you ship must be robust enough for company-wide adoption.
- Measure efficiency: You will define success in time saved, cost reduced, risk removed, and adoption by internal teams, and prioritise against it.
- Align stakeholders: You will be the point of contact for internal stakeholders across Engineering, Ops, Finance, Legal, Data and Care, structuring their demands and arbitrating between them.

Who we're looking for

- Experience: You have 2+ years of experience as a Product Manager. A background on internal tools, back-office products, APIs, platforms, or complex B2B products is a strong plus.
- Product for teams mindset: You are comfortable building for internal users, where the bar is efficiency, robustness and adoption. Problems nobody outside the company will ever see still energise you.
- AI fluency - hands-on: This scope is being rebuilt around agents, so this criterion carries the most weight. You use AI tools daily in your own work, you understand what agents are actually good and bad at, and you have opinions about where automation belongs.
- Strong technical appetite: You are curious and hands-on with infrastructure, permissions, reliability, security, compliance, and data architecture. Coding is not required, but you need to understand how things work.
- Stakeholder leadership: You are excellent at alignment, prioritization, and saying no. You can navigate many dependencies and make trade-offs explicit.
- Analytical & pragmatic: You are data-driven, impact-oriented, and you go straight for the real operational problem.
- Communication: You are a clear, structured communicator, able to translate complex technical topics into business impact.
- Location: Based in France or Spain.
- Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional.
- Mindset: You are ownership-driven, resilient, and motivated by solving hard, unglamorous but high-impact problems that make the whole company better. You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better.

Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

- Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.
- Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

- Top-market compensation
- Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build
- Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills
- Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings
- Contribution to your ClassPass subscription
- 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent
- ...and much more, check the full list !

Our hiring process
- Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.
- Step 1 - Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you'd join, or colleagues from other teams).
- Step 2 - Role-specific assessments

- For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).
- For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).
- Step 3 - Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.
- References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation Range: €64K - €104K

Bienvenue chez Joko

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. Détail du poste


Health can't wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a sixmonth appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that's exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can't.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it's coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It's not solely a question of willpower. It's the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Product Manager - Sales AI

The product manager role

Product Managers at Alan go deep on user needs, define a clear product strategy, and turn it into a high-impact roadmap.

- You will work closely with designers, engineers and sales teams to define the right product and build it.
- You will partner and align with every part of the business: sales, sales effectiveness, and our AI platform teams.

Sales AI: an exceptional opportunity to have an impact and grow

- Our sales teams sell health insurance, a field that demands real expertise. Our internal tools have become powerful but fragmented, and AI is fundamentally reshaping how humans and tools interact. Alan's growth ambitions are high: reaching them requires a step change in sales effectiveness - in time spent and in win rate.
- So we are rethinking the entire sales experience from the ground up. Instead of tools Account Executives have to remember to open and prompt, we want an AI that works for the rep, including when they are not there: it processes information, analyzes a large pipeline of parallel deals, and comes back with here is the priority today, do this and this. A true assistant that helps reps prioritize, prepares work for them, and lets them build faster, more relevant offers, with the right sales material and arguments. With everything we know about past offers and the market, we can massively empower reps to walk in with a sharper offer and a sharper pitch.
- The scope spans the full funnel: top funnel (automating prospection so reps get more, better-qualified discovery) and bottom funnel (winning offers, stronger pitches, higher win rate). Alan has strong maturity here: voice AI is live in France and Spain, outbound campaigns run autonomously, the CRM fills itself from call transcripts, and our offer copilot is used by more than half our reps - around 20% productivity gained this year. The limit today is structural: every capability lives in a separate tool, behind a manual trigger.
- This is a validated, high-ambition bet to reinvent the sales experience, lift sales efficiency and win rate, and give every one of our clients a large-account-grade experience. And it does not stop at internal tooling: the same engine, pointed outward, can reach and answer customers directly in our self-serve funnel, and the approach can then be extended to other parts of Alan.

What you will own

- Reinvent the sales workflow. Move our Account Executives and Key Account Managers from siloed AI tools they have to remember to use, to AI that proactively pushes the right action at the right moment in their workflow.
- Build and sequence the roadmap. The scope is broad, so you will decide where to start, prioritize the highest-impact automation over nice to have AI features, and sequence the path to the full vision.
- Get hands-on. We build many of our tools in an everyone can build mode. You will work close to the engine room, writing prompts, wiring connectors and evaluating outputs, to understand what is really happening and unblock progress.
- Empower better, faster selling. Bring together what we know about offers, content and market signals so reps produce sharper offers faster - and automate the prospection work that fills their pipeline in the first place.
- Keep the experience coherent. Partner closely with adjacent teams building AI agents in neighboring areas, so the overall experience stays consistent rather than siloed.
- Drive the outcomes. Minimize time spent on low-value work while lifting offer relevance, win rate and the volume of qualified conversations each rep can run - so their time goes only to what needs a human.

About you

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have:

- At least 5 years in a product management role (or equivalent product ownership) in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment, ideally with AI or agentic products. Seniority matters here: the scope is exploratory and not fully defined yet.
- Genuine excitement for AI. You have built AI products, or you are deeply eager to learn how LLM-based systems and agents behave in production, including their failure modes, and you can reason about the shift from pull-based to proactive, push-based experiences.
- A builder mindset. You are hands-on and comfortable close to the product's engine room (connectors, prompts, skills, evaluation) to understand what is really happening and unblock progress.
- Appetite for the sales and insurance business. You are happy to sit with a rep, review an offer, and learn how guarantees and consumption terms are expressed, then turn that into product vision. You do not need to be a sales or insurance expert already, but you want to go deep fast.
- Strong product execution. You set measurable goals, prioritize effectively, and ship iteratively, balancing quality, speed and impact.
- The ability to bridge technical and non-technical worlds. You translate between platform and engineering constraints and sales reality, and drive alignment through clear framing and sharp decision-making.
- Experience influencing without full authority. You can build the case for a new, ambitious bet and rally people around it.
- Strong written communication in both internal and external-facing settings.
- Fluency in French and English.

For this role, we hire within the

How we work

Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France.

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application

Check out our and pages, as well as our , and for more info.

You want to know more about Alan?

: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it. Having reached profitability in our core market, we're now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. It's still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us! Our Product Team Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams. Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value: - Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team. - Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app. - Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell. - AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability. The AI Platform tribe AI Platform's mission is to turn Joko into a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside. The tribe builds the internal agent infrastructure that will let every team work faster, automate complex workflows, and create new 0-to-1 features with AI. Its flagship product is Joker, Joko's internal AI teammate. Already live in Slack, Notion and Linear, Joker can understand context, use tools, act across systems, and take real work from idea to execution. The ambition is not just to automate repetitive tasks, but to make agents a new production layer for how Joko builds and operates. For this to work at company scale, AI Platform also owns the backbone underneath: Gotham, the identity and permission layer that lets agents act with exactly the access of the person they work for; plus the internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security, reliability and server-cost foundations that keep Joko fast, safe and scalable. The tribe's users are the teams inside Joko. Its goal is simple: help them run extremely efficient processes, remove operational bottlenecks, and give the company the leverage it needs to scale in the coming years. What you will do As Lead Product Manager for the Platform tribe, your mission is to make Joko's own machine faster, safer and increasingly agentic. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, own the tribe's roadmap end to end, and lead the Product Managers on its task forces as the team grows. The tribe is being staffed right now, so expect to be hands-on from day one on scopes you own personally, and to build the function as the team grows. - Set the tribe's strategy: You will decide what Platform builds, in what order, and what it stops doing. You will map what teams across the company do today in our internal tools, what it costs them and what they need next, then turn that into a roadmap you can defend in front of leadership. This intake runs permanently, as a standing part of the job. - Own Joker and Gotham: These are the tribe's most strategic bets and you will drive them personally. Taking Joker from what it is today to a production-grade agent platform, and shipping Gotham's permission model so agents never hold more access than the person they act for, is the highest-leverage work in your scope. - Build the automation layer: The approach is capability first: expose an action as a scoped tool, write the instructions an agent needs to use it well, then let the agent run the job. Interfaces come only where they earn their place, and deciding what still deserves a screen is a genuinely new kind of product judgment. - Retire what should not exist: Part of the mandate is subtractive: migrating off tools that have outlived their purpose and progressively switching off legacy systems, without breaking the teams that depend on them every day. - Own security, compliance and reliability: Identity and access, data retention and minimization, log centralization, audit, test coverage. The requirement often comes from Legal or an auditor, and still has to be shaped into something people will actually adopt. - Lead and grow the team: You will hire, mentor and lead the Product Managers who own the tribe's task forces, set the bar on discovery and delivery, and be the person the tribe's engineers and designers look to for product direction. - Be the interface for the whole company: You will be the point of contact for Engineering, Ops, Finance, Legal, Data and Care, structuring their demands and arbitrating between them. You will define success in time saved, cost removed, risk reduced and adoption by internal teams, and report on it in those terms. Who we're looking for - Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in Product, including experience leading or mentoring other Product Managers. A background on internal tools, back-office products, APIs, platforms or complex B2B products is a strong plus. - AI fluency, hands-on: This scope is being rebuilt around agents, so this criterion carries the most weight. You use AI tools daily in your own work, you understand what agents are actually good and bad at, and you have opinions about where automation belongs and where a human interface still earns its place. - Product for teams mindset: You are comfortable building for internal users, where the bar is efficiency, robustness and adoption rather than polish. Problems nobody outside the company will ever see still energise you. If what drives you is craft on a consumer surface seen by millions, this scope will frustrate you. - Strong technical appetite: You are curious and hands-on with infrastructure, identity, permissions, reliability, security, compliance and data architecture. Coding is not required, but you need to understand how things work. - Management: You have a proven track record in people management. You know how to grow Product Managers, set a high bar for rigor, and give direction without taking every decision yourself. - Stakeholder leadership: You are excellent at alignment, prioritization and saying no. You can navigate many dependencies, arbitrate between senior stakeholders, and make trade-offs explicit. - Analytical & pragmatic: You are data-driven, impact-oriented, and you go straight for the real operational problem. - Communication: You are a clear, structured communicator, able to translate complex technical topics into business impact for the exec team. - Location: Based in France or Spain. - Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional. - Mindset: You are ownership-driven, resilient, and motivated by solving hard, unglamorous but high-impact problems that make the whole company better. You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better. Our perks (Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only) At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through: - Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget. - Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year. On top of that, we offer plenty of perks: - Top-market compensation - Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build - Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills - Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings - Contribution to your ClassPass subscription - 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent - ...and much more, check the full list ! We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design). - For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool). - Step 3 - Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder. - References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers. You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture. hellowork.descriptionHtml:
Les missions du poste


Singulier is a strategy, transaction advisory and AI transformation consulting firm supporting

private equity funds, portfolio companies and established businesses on their most critical

strategic and operational challenges. We combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution

to help our clients make better decisions, accelerate value creation and deliver tangible

business impact.

Singulier x OMMAX are joining forces to build a leading European AI management consulting

platform, combining deep strategic expertise with technology, data and AI capabilities.

Together, we support clients across the full value creation journey, from strategy and due

diligence through transformation and execution.

We operate in a partner-led, entrepreneurial environment where consultants are expected to

think critically, take ownership early, work directly with senior stakeholders and contribute to

building long-term client impact.



Who we are

Singulier provides strategic, transaction advisory and transformation support to private equity funds and established companies. We help our clients unlock value through AI, data, technology and digital transformation, combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution to deliver rapid and sustainable impact.

Our team of approximately 80 professionals across London, Paris and Munich brings together strategy consultants and technical experts across AI, data, technology, product and customer experience.

As part of the continued development of our Transaction Advisory practice, we support investors and management teams throughout the investment lifecycle, from investment evaluation and due diligence to post-deal value creation and transformation.

What you'll do

As a Senior Manager, you will play a key role in the growth of Singulier's AI, Data & Technology Advisory practice.

You will lead complex Due Diligence, Value Creation and Transformation engagements, manage senior client relationships, contribute to business development activities and help shape the future of our Transaction Advisory offering.

You will work directly with Private Equity funds, portfolio company executives, founders and C-level stakeholders on critical strategic, operational and technology-related decisions.

Transaction Advisory, Due Diligence & Value Creation

Responsibilities

- Lead Technology, Digital, Data and AI Due Diligence engagements for Private Equity clients
- Assess technology architectures, engineering organizations, product operating models and delivery capabilities
- Evaluate AI maturity, AI operating models, GenAI adoption and AI-enabled value creation opportunities
- Assess technical debt, cybersecurity, scalability and operational risks
- Identify growth, productivity, operational efficiency and margin improvement opportunities enabled by AI, Data and Technology
- Develop investment recommendations and executive-level deliverables
- Present findings and recommendations to investment teams, boards and executive stakeholders
- Support post-acquisition value creation planning and portfolio transformation initiatives
- Contribute to the development of Singulier's Due Diligence methodologies and market positioning

AI, Data & Technology Transformation

Responsibilities

- Lead AI, Data and Technology transformation programs for corporate and PE-backed clients
- Define AI and GenAI strategies, operating models and governance frameworks
- Identify, prioritize and scale high-value AI use cases
- Design Data & AI transformation roadmaps
- Support companies AI adoption and change management initiatives
- Advise clients on technology strategy, operating model design and organizational transformation
- Support AI-enabled product, customer experience and operational excellence initiatives
- Drive execution of strategic transformation programs and value creation plans

Client Leadership & Business Development

Responsibilities

- Build trusted relationships with senior executives, investors and client stakeholders
- Lead proposal development and contribute to commercial opportunity shaping
- Identify opportunities within existing client relationships and support account growth
- Contribute to the expansion of Singulier's AI, Data & Technology Advisory business
- Participate in thought leadership initiatives, market visibility and practice development
- Support the development of strategic partnerships within the AI, Data and Technology ecosystem

Team Leadership & Firm Building

Responsibilities

- Lead multiple projects and workstreams simultaneously
- Coach, develop and mentor Consultants, Senior Consultants and Managers
- Ensure delivery excellence across teams and engagements
- Contribute to knowledge building, methodology development and asset creation
- Participate actively in recruitment and talent development initiatives
- Help shape the culture, capabilities and long-term growth of the firm

Le profil recherché

Work at the intersection of AI, Data, Technology, Private Equity and Transaction Advisory Advise investors, portfolio companies and C-level executives on critical investment and transformation decisions Lead high-impact Due Diligence, Value Creation and Transformation engagements Play a key role in building and scaling a fast-growing AI, Data & Technology Advisory practice Benefit from significant exposure to senior leadership and entrepreneurial responsibility Help shape the future of one of Europe's most ambitious advisory firmsMaster's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business or a related field from a leading university 6-10 years of experience in strategy consulting, technology consulting, AI advisory, transaction advisory, private equity support or a related environment Proven experience leading Technology, Digital, Data and/or AI Due Diligence engagements Strong experience leading complex transformation and value creation programs Strong understanding of AI ecosystems, GenAI, LLMs, enterprise AI adoption and AI operating models Strong understanding of technology architectures, cloud environments, software delivery models and data platforms Ability to connect technology decisions to business outcomes and value creation opportunities Experience managing senior client relationships and influencing executive stakeholders Strong project leadership, team management and coaching capabilities Demonstrated contribution to business development activities and commercial opportunities Entrepreneurial mindset and willingness to contribute beyond client delivery Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, international and high-growth environment Fluency in French and English

Les missions du poste

Depuis 2021, Team.is accompagne les startups, scale-ups et entreprises innovantes, industries de pointe et entreprises de services dans leurs recrutements les plus stratégiques, en France comme à l'international.

AI, GenAI, DeepTech, Tech, Gaming, Industrie ou fonctions Business critiques : nous identifions et attirons les talents capables d'accélérer la croissance, l'innovation et l'exécution.

Grâce à une approche AI-powered, une connaissance approfondie des marchés et une expertise en headhunting, nous relevons les défis de recrutement les plus complexes et les plus pénuriques.

En postulant à cette offre, vous aurez l'opportunité de rejoindre un acteur majeur du digital, qui accompagne depuis plus de 15 ans des entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux à fort impact.
Avec une croissance continue (+15 % par an), l'entreprise rassemble aujourd'hui plus de 700 collaborateurs passionnés et s'est structurée en plusieurs entités spécialisées autour des technologies, de la data, du cloud ou encore de l'IA.
Son ambition : atteindre 1 500 collaborateurs dans les 3 prochaines années.

Votre mission si vous l'acceptez :

- Ton objectif sera de créer les solutions d'IA qui apportent de la valeur aux clients, de la conception technique au monitoring en production.
- Tu travailleras sur des projets d'IA traditionnels (détection d'objet, prédiction de ventes, ...) et/ou d'IA générative (RAG, Agents, ...).
- Tu seras garant de livrer le produit le plus qualitatif dans les temps impartis, de faire progresser ton équipe et de l'amélioration continue.
- Tes projets seront dans diverses industries (santé, fintech, retail, publique, ...)
- Tu travailleras dans une équipe typiquement constituée d'un Engineering Manager, pour te challenger et t'aider à réussir, de 1-3 AI engineer que tu coacheras, et d'un Product Manager.
- Tu pourras contribuer au développement de nos convictions techniques en interne (e.g. formation, prise d'initiative, ...) et en externe (conférences, articles, discussions avec les clients, ...)
- Tu progresseras et feras progresser la boite, en étant actif et en proposant de nouvelles initiatives dans la communauté tech: guildes, formations, etc.
- Tu évolueras dans une culture fortement impactée par le lean qui encourage l'amélioration constante et met l'accent sur la valeur

Hymaïa est l'accélérateur de la transformation Data & IA des entreprises. Experts tech, IA et Produit, nous aidons les individus, équipes et organisations à repenser leur quotidien et leurs produits à l'ère de l'IA.

Rejoindre Hymaïa, c'est faire partie d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, passionnée, qui allie expertise technique de pointe, vision produit et approche organisationnelle pragmatique. C'est une équipe à taille humaine, qui ne se contente pas que de conseiller : nous développons, nous montrons par l'exemple et nous formons.

Si tu souhaites être au coeur de l'écosystème Data & IA français, tu es au bon endroit.

Hymaïa, c'est avant tout une volonté d'être un Hub de partage et de savoir, avec un fort ancrage communautaire. Tu auras donc l'opportunité d'avoir un impact fort à travers nos conférences comme la Forward Data Conference et l'AI Product Day ou encore en devenant un formateur.ice via nos formations techniques, IA et produit certifiées.



LE CONTEXTE :

Nous recherchons un·e Data Product Manager pour rejoindre notre practice Data & AI Product Management. Tu interviens en mission chez nos clients sur des produits data : plateformes analytiques, self-service data, data products exposés aux métiers ou aux utilisateurs finaux. Tu pilotes la valeur produit à partir de la donnée, et tu sais utiliser l'IA pour aller plus vite, mieux cadrer les sujets et prendre de meilleures décisions.

TES MISSIONS :

Stratégie & Discovery

- Définir la vision produit data et aligner la roadmap sur les OKRs du client
- Mener la recherche utilisateur : entretiens avec les équipes data et métiers, analytics, benchmark
- Identifier et prioriser les data products à fort impact : tableaux de bord, pipelines exposés, features data dans le produit
- Utiliser les LLMs pour accélérer la discovery : synthèse d'entretiens, scoring des opportunités, génération de JTBD

Delivery & Collaboration data

- Piloter le backlog orienté valeur en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Data Engineering et Analytics Engineering
- Tenir la posture PO : cadrer les user stories data, animer les rituels, arbitrer les priorités
- Challenger les équipes sur la qualité, la documentation et l'accessibilité des données
- Garantir la couverture du tracking produit et la fiabilité des métriques exposées aux métiers

Impact & Mesure

- Définir et suivre les KPIs d'adoption des data products : usage, qualité perçue, autonomie des équipes métiers
- Produire des analyses pour éclairer les décisions produit et piloter la valeur livrée
- Partager tes apprentissages au sein de la practice PM Hymaïa

Une rencontre privilégiée avec François (notre CEO) ou Yoann (notre co-fondateur).Même si ton profil ne coche pas toutes les cases à 100%, nous t'encourageons vivement à postuler ou envoyer un message à Maëva Iguenane.C'est ta personnalité et ton potentiel qui nous intéressent ! 😉

hellowork.title: Lead Mobile Engineer H/F
hellowork.descriptionHtml:
Détail du poste


Ouihelp s'attaque à un vrai challenge de société : permettre aux 2 millions de français en perte d'autonomie de vivre dans les meilleures conditions et le plus longtemps possible à l'endroit qu'ils ont choisi. Pour renforcer l'équipe coeur, Ouihelp cherche aujourd'hui un(e) Lead(se) Mobile passionné(e) et ambitieux(se) pour accompagner le développement produit, indispensable à l'accélération de l'activité et à la réussite de cette aventure humaine.

Mission

- Porter l'excellence technique d'une équipe produit et l'ownership tech de nos applications mobiles, en tirant parti de l'IA comme levier de productivité et de qualité

- Garantir la qualité, la vélocité et la maintenabilité du delivery de l'équipe produit et de nos apps mobiles (iOS/Android), tout en améliorant les pratiques de développement AI au sein de l'équipe.

- Delivery régulier et de qualité (Right First Time Rate élevé, DORA metrics saines)

- Applications mobiles stables, performantes et pérennes

- Adoption effective des workflows AI-first dans l'équipe

Outcomes

Tech lead ownership d'une équipe produit - 60%

- Porter les décisions d'architecture et de design technique de l'équipe.

- Garantir la qualité du code, des reviews et des pratiques de test.

- Débloquer et faire monter en compétence les ingénieurs de l'équipe.

- Sécuriser le delivery : découpage, priorisation technique, gestion de la dette.

- Gérer la relation produit et design

Ownership tech des applications mobiles - 30%

- Définir et maintenir l'architecture mobile (iOS/Android) en lien avec le Staff.

- Garantir la stabilité, la performance et l'observabilité des apps en production.

- Piloter la roadmap technique mobile (montées de version, refactos, CI/CD mobile).

- Assurer la cohérence des choix mobiles avec la stratégie tech globale.

Installer une pratique de développement AI-first - 10%

- Diffuser les bonnes pratiques d'usage des agents, harness et loops dans l'équipe.

- Outiller l'équipe (skills, MCP, contextes) pour maximiser la productivité IA.

- Mesurer et améliorer l'impact réel de l'IA sur le delivery.

Profil

- XP minimum : 6 ans

- Stack: Expo, react native, python, typescript, PostgreSQL

Critical competencies

- System design & architecture - conçoit des systèmes robustes et évolutifs, anticipe les contraintes de scale et de maintenabilité, et sait faire les bons arbitrages techniques dans la durée.

- Leadership technique & mentoring - élève le niveau de l'équipe, porte les décisions techniques structurantes, et fait grandir les ingénieurs par la revue, le pairing et le coaching.

- AI fluency & practice - maîtrise concrète du travail avec les LLM : agents, models, harness, loops, context engineering. Sait construire et itérer des workflows AI-native, pas juste utiliser un chat.

- Product builder - pense en termes de valeur utilisateur et d'impact business, pas seulement de code. Sait arbitrer, shipper, et itérer vite sur ce qui compte.

- Code - écrit et fait écrire du code clair, testé et maintenable, avec un sens aigu de la qualité et du pragmatisme d'exécution.

Critical mindset

- Growth mindset - apprend en continu, cherche le feedback, se remet en question et progresse vite, notamment sur des techs et pratiques en évolution rapide.

- Pragmatique - cherche l'impact réel plutôt que la perfection théorique, sait faire des compromis assumés et livrer ce qui compte au bon niveau de qualité.

- Ownership - se sent responsable de bout en bout, du problème à la mise en production, et ne lâche pas un sujet tant qu'il n'est pas réellement résolu.

- Enthousiaste - incarne et promeut une énergie positive et un élan collectif, embarque l'équipe dans le changement et donne envie de tirer la barre vers le haut.

Pourquoi rejoindre ?

L'impact
Permettre à des personnes en perte d'autonomie de rester chez elles. Ce que vous shippez change le quotidien de 20 000 bénéficiaires et de 10 000 auxiliaires de vie.

Le cadre

- Télétravail 3 jours minimum par semaine, où que vous soyez en France (des agences Ouihelp dans toute la France)

- Rassemblement d'équipe à Paris 2 jours par mois (frais pris en charge)

- Claude Code Max offert

- Entreprise rentable et en croissance

Le package

- 65 000 € - 80 000 € brut annuel selon expérience

- Mutuelle prise en charge à 80 % et prévoyance

Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Chez Ouihelp, la tech n'est pas un support : c'est ce qui permet de coordonner 10 000 auxiliaires de vie auprès de 20 000 bénéficiaires, chaque jour, dans 100 villes. Nos applications mobiles sont devenues le poste de travail des auxiliaires et le lien de confiance des familles. Elles portent aujourd'hui une part critique de l'activité.

Deux choses arrivent en même temps :

- Les apps mobiles deviennent stratégiques. Elles ont été construites vite, pour tenir la croissance. Elles ont maintenant besoin d'un propriétaire technique : quelqu'un qui tranche l'architecture, tient la qualité en production, et arbitre la dette dans la durée.

- La transformation AI-first est engagée. Claude Code est déployé, reste à passer de « des gens qui utilisent des agents » à une vraie pratique d'équipe : outillée, mesurée, partagée. Le terrain est quasi vierge, la personne qui arrive écrit les standards.

Vous ne serez pas seul(e) : vous co-construisez les standards techniques mobiles avec Paul, notre Staff Engineer, et vous portez le leadership technique d'une équipe produit déjà constituée.

Process

- Screening 30min

- Discussion orga / mission - EM - 1h

- Case study System design mobile + AI-native - en live 1h30

- Fit product - CPO / PM - 45 min

- Fit tech/leadership avec CTO - 45 min

- Contrôle de ref

hellowork.title: Senior Product Manager B2c H/F
hellowork.descriptionHtml:
Les missions du poste


Dayuse ouvre les portes des hôtels en journée à une nouvelle clientèle en quête d'expériences inédites. Sublimer son quotidien, partager des moments forts, vivre l'instant présent : autant de possibilités que d'hôtels à découvrir près de chez soi le temps de quelques heures. Transformer les hôtels en lieux de vie, c'est la mission de Dayuse qui démocratise cette nouvelle tendance lifestyle. Le leader mondial de la réservation d'expériences à l'hôtel en journée a généré près d'un milliard d'euros en volume d'affaires à ses 10 500 partenaires dans 30 pays depuis sa création.



About Dayuse

Somewhere in the world, right now, someone is deciding where to spend their day. You decide what they see.

Dayuse is the world leader in day-use hotel experiences: a room, a pool, a spa for the day, a quiet place to work or recharge. We connect 5 million monthly users with 10,000 partner hotels in 30 countries, and help hoteliers earn revenue from spaces that would otherwise sit empty. The world's largest hotel groups work with us, including Accor, Hilton, Marriott and IHG. Our users rate us 4.9 on the app stores and 4.8 on Trustpilot. The sun never sets on Dayuse: someone is booking right now in Paris, New York, Dubai or Singapore.

Why this role matters now

Here, you write the future of Dayuse. Our product has grown by double digits every year, and in 2027 we launch new products and verticals. You will practise product management as it is becoming: building has become cheap, so deciding what to build and proving it worked is now the heart of the job. Our product team keeps evolving and strengthening its capabilities, and so will your scope and impact.

What you won't find elsewhere

- The scope of a scale-up, the scale of a big tech. Elsewhere you optimise one step of the funnel. Here you own the whole B2C experience and build the strategy with the CPO and leadership. Your ownership and your ambition have no ceiling.
- An AI story we are writing now, and fast. We started early, and the most interesting part is still ahead. You will build it alongside our AI Platform team, who help you grow.
- Data decides. From small tweaks to big bets, we test. Results regularly prove our preconceived ideas wrong, and that keeps us humble. Nobody wins an argument by seniority.
- Decisions in hours, not weeks. Marketing and sales sit in the same office and are always available. You align, decide and move on the same day.

What you will own

- An experience that adapts to each user. One size fits none. Home, search and funnel should change with the country, the intent (business, leisure, family) and whether you are a first-timer or a repeater.
- Search and discovery. Semantic search, recommendation and ML ranking, built hand in hand with our data scientists, so users find the right hotel in seconds.
- Conversion and pricing. You are a conversion hunter. Price display, fees, basket, add-ons and payment: you know what half a point of conversion is worth, and you prove it with A/B tests.
- Agentic product. Making Dayuse discoverable and bookable wherever users now search, including AI assistants and conversational interfaces.
- Your product strategy. You set the vision and arbitrate the B2C roadmap, with a dedicated squad: a junior PM you mentor, our Principal Product Designer, our CRO, web, app and back-end developers, and data scientists. You defend your choices with data, and get leadership, marketing and the account managers who work with our hotels on board.

How you will work

- You build. You prototype and ship small changes to production yourself, through a merge request reviewed, for now, by a developer. Our developers code with agents and our QA is automated, so the team moves fast without cutting corners.
- You delegate to agents. Our PM agents prepare specs, story splitting, tracking plans and research synthesis. Your time goes to judgement: what to build, for whom, and why.
- You analyse yourself. An insight agent and a structured data stack with a semantic layer give you direct access to the numbers. You write SQL when needed and never wait for a dashboard to make a decision.
- You go to the field. You interview users in several countries and languages, and turn what you hear into bets.

Our stack

Claude (PM and insight agents) · Amplitude · SQL and a semantic layer · Maze · Figma and a design system in the code · GitLab · Notion · HubSpot · Modjo · internal tools built with AI.

Your first six months

- Month 1: your hands are already dirty: a first change shipped, a first A/B test launched, your first user interviews done, and your reading of the three biggest B2C levers shared.
- Month 3: you have interviewed users in at least three countries, several of your A/B tests are live, and your first learnings are shaping the roadmap.
- Month 6: you have a documented win on conversion or basket value. You present and defend a product strategy with clear targets, measured KPIs and a follow-up plan to stakeholders. The junior PM you mentor runs a topic end to end.

What you bring

- 6+ years in product management, including 3+ on a high-traffic B2C product (marketplace, travel, e-commerce). Sharp product sense and UX sensitivity: you spot friction in a flow at first glance, and you care about the details that make booking feel effortless.
- A track record of moving business metrics, proven by experimentation. You know sample size, test power and when a result is noise.
- Evidence that you build: a prototype, an AI tool, a side project, code in production. Please share a link.
- Senior stakeholder skills: you align leadership and operational teams without formal authority.
- First experience managing or mentoring a PM.
- Fluent English and professional fluency in French are required (you will interview users in English). Other languages are a strong plus.
- You have already led a bet that moved a company-level metric, not just your squad's.

Strong plus: experience in hospitality, travel or two-sided marketplaces; pricing and revenue topics.

This role is for you if...

- You want to own a strategy, not execute someone else's.
- You open the numbers before giving your opinion, and you enjoy being proven wrong by a test.
- You are as comfortable challenging pricing as spotting friction in a user flow.
- You have started building with AI, and you want to go much further.
- Talking to a user in Singapore in the morning and making a call with marketing in the afternoon sounds like a good day.

Hiring process
- Call with our People team.
- Interview with our CPO.
- Live case study with our COO and CPO. You get the brief 48 hours before; AI tools are welcome.
- Meetings with our Lead Tech and product managers, to get to know the team.

Additional benefits

- Up to 2 days of remote working per week
- A competitive compensation package: fixed salary + variable compensation + profit-sharing scheme
- €10 SWILE meal vouchers, with 50% covered by the company
- 25 days of paid leave + 6 RTT days per year
- Company health insurance, 50% covered by the company
- Public transport subscription, 50% reimbursed
- A Welcome Campus providing a comprehensive onboarding experience at the heart of the company and its teams
- Multicultural teams across 3 continents, committed, supportive, and passionate about the product
- Company events throughout the year, including lunches, parties, and drinks
- Offices in Paris' 9th arrondissement, in a lively neighborhood with everything you need within easy reach

APPLICATION PROCESSING

At Dayuse, we believe in diversity and in recognizing potential beyond a CV. That's why we do NOT use automated AI screening for applications. Every application is reviewed manually by our in-house recruiters to ensure equal opportunities and prevent any form of discrimination.

Ready to take on this challenge and make a tangible impact on Dayuse's growth? Join us!

Bienvenue chez Dayuse

Dayuse ouvre les portes des hôtels en journée à une nouvelle clientèle en quête d'expériences inédites. Sublimer son quotidien, partager des moments forts, vivre l'instant présent : autant de possibilités que d'hôtels à découvrir près de chez soi le temps de quelques heures. Transformer les hôtels en lieux de vie, c'est la mission de Dayuse qui démocratise cette nouvelle tendance lifestyle. Le leader mondial de la réservation d'expériences à l'hôtel en journée a généré près d'un milliard d'euros en volume d'affaires à ses 10 500 partenaires dans 30 pays depuis sa création.
